prompts.opening_context: It is reaching out to a company that might outsource its supplement production.
prompts.relevance_intro: {name} makes food supplements for other companies' brands. Its clients are companies in EUROPE that sell supplements under a name of their own and could have them made by {name}.
relevance_no: it is a CONTRACT or private-label MANUFACTURER of supplements or medicines: it offers to make products FOR other companies' brands, so it is a competitor, not a buyer;
it is a news or media site, a job board, a directory, a school, a hospital, or a company in an industry that has nothing to do with supplements, health foods or wellness products.
relevance_yes: a supplement, vitamin, sports-nutrition, herbal or wellness BRAND, also a small one that makes its own products in its own lab, kitchen, farm or workshop;
a distributor, online shop, retailer, health-food shop, pharmacy or pharmacy chain that sells supplements;
a company of these kinds whose text does not say where it is based.
prompts.relevance_judge_note: Judge by what the company does, not by a word in its name: "Laboratoires", "Lab" or "Pharma" in a name does not make it a manufacturer, and making its own products does not make it a contract manufacturer.
prompts.country_context: an Italian manufacturer of food supplements
prompts.strategist_targets: (supplement/vitamin/sports-nutrition/wellness BRANDS, distributors, retailers, pharmacies) that might OUTSOURCE their supplement production to {name}
prompts.strategist_verticals: food supplements, nutraceuticals, vitamins, minerals, probiotics, omega/collagen, sports nutrition (protein, pre-workout), herbal/botanical supplements, beauty-from-within / nutricosmetics
prompts.strategist_query_rule: Each query = vertical + a BUYER company type (brand / company / distributor / retailer / online shop / pharmacy) + a European country. Do NOT use "manufacturer" or "contract manufacturer" - those are {name}'s competitors, not clients. Do NOT use the words {name} uses for itself either (CDMO, private label, white label, third party, turnkey, ready to market / RTM, formulation, packaging, conto terzi, looking for, seeking): a search for what {name} is finds its competitors.
